description: Second, additive L1/G6 task set for the 2026-11-23 Gemini online feedback join. It does NOT modify explore/tasks-online-gap.json (N1–N9), tasks-smoke.json, tasks-g6.json, src/, scripts/, README, or workflows. Every task is schema-compatible with the existing G6/smoke shape (id/server/tool/prompt/source/category/expectedTools/authority) plus name/expectedOps, and carries a buildAxis field for same-prompt/same-build pairing (prod-old-2026-11-23 vs checkout-current). NO network, NO real credentials, NO real writes: every task is dryRun-by-default with forRealWrite=false and fake/replay preconditions. requestIds stay unknown: this batch never fabricates a UUID. No commit/push/deploy.

buildAxes.rule: Run the same prompt/fixture once per build, each with a fresh sessionId; never subtract a baseline-build observation from a candidate-build result.

tasks.name: same-build-byte-exact-postcondition-f1
tasks.prompt: Same-build paired byte-exact postcondition for F1. Use the canonical fake fixture RAW={text:'successfully downloaded text file (SHA: <hex>)\n'+body, resources:[{text:body}]} with CJK + trailing newline. For each build axis separately (prod-old-2026-11-23 observation first, then checkout-current), call github__get_file_contents, normalize, apply a one-line patch, perform readback, and record: readbackByteEq, noticeLeakCount, shaFromNotice. Assert on the candidate build that normalizeFileResult(RAW).content === body byte-for-byte, content does not start with 'successfully downloaded', sha equals the notice SHA, and readback === intendedBody. The baseline-build observation is a labeled reference ONLY: never compute a cross-build delta or claim the live site is fixed. dryRun=true and forRealWrite=false: the write step is a fake writer. Closes F1/G1+G2; complements N1/N9 without editing them.
preconditions: fake upstream fixture RAW={text:notice+body, resources:[{text:body}]}; body has CJK + trailing newline
one fresh sessionId per build axis; no cross-build hard comparison
no real token, no network, no real write; requestIds unknown

tasks.name: same-build-canonical-pr-number-f2
tasks.prompt: Same-build paired canonical PR number check for F2. Use PR_REAL={id:5444514334, html_url:'https://api.github.com/repos/o/r/pulls/53', number:999 (deliberately disagreeing)}. For each build axis separately, call github__pull_request_read and record number, id, idAsPrNumberCount, numberSource. Assert on the candidate build that number === 53 taken from the URL, id is preserved as string '5444514334', and number !== Number(id); then assert a fake subsequent merge would target 53 and not 999. PR #53 is an external fact, not a gateway capture proof; the baseline-build observation is labeled reference only, no cross-build delta. dryRun=true and forRealWrite=false: no real merge. Closes F2/G1+G2; complements N3 without editing it.
preconditions: PR_REAL fixture with id=5444514334 and url .../pull/53; number field deliberately disagrees
one fresh sessionId per build axis; no cross-build hard comparison
no real token, no network, no real merge; requestIds unknown

tasks.name: batch-wrapper-contract-f3
tasks.prompt: Online-only axis: batch wrapper contract for F3. With a fake upstream, issue one concurrent batch of calls that returns three shapes in the same batch: a bare value, {ok:true,value}, and a gateway envelope. Assert after the unified helper (unwrap/safeAll) that (a) every successful slot resolves at the SAME unwrap depth to the same final value shape, (b) a failing slot is consistently {ok:false,value} (or the documented failure slot) at the same depth, and (c) the caller never has to branch on the upstream wrapper kind. Record wrapperUnwrapDepthConsistent=true and failureSlotShapeOk=true. This axis did not exist in N1–N9 (N9 only tests atomic writes). Status is needs-repro: if the checkout contract disagrees, record the exact fake fixture and stop; do not claim fixed. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no network, no real credentials.
preconditions: fake upstream returns mixed bare/{ok,value}/envelope shapes in one concurrent batch
needs-repro: record exact fixture if contract is inconsistent; no assumption of 'already fixed'
no real token, no network, no real write; requestIds unknown

tasks.name: truncation-tail-metadata-f4
tasks.prompt: Online-only axis: truncation TAIL metadata for F4. With a fake upstream, read a body larger than the response cap whose LAST lines contain a key field (e.g. 'summary: OK'). Assert that truncation, when it happens, carries explicit metadata: truncated=true plus limit/original counts, and that the trailing key field is either present in the retained window or explicitly surfaced as omitted — never silently hard-cut away. Record truncationTailMetadataOk=true and tailKeyFieldAccountedFor=true. A truncated read is a hard stop: no patch/write is attempted. This is stricter than N5/N6 (which only assert a flag/hard-stop/paginated byte equality). Status is needs-repro: if the checkout drops tail metadata, record the fixture and stop. dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no network.
preconditions: fake oversized body with trailing 'summary: OK' key field above response cap
needs-repro: record exact fixture if tail metadata is dropped; no assumption of 'already fixed'
no real token, no network, no real write; requestIds unknown

tasks.name: atomic-by-default-multi-file-write-f5
tasks.prompt: Online-only axis: atomic-by-default multi-file write for F5. With N fake files and the k-th write failing, assert that a multi-file edit is atomic WITHOUT the caller declaring atomicity: either all N files commit in one push_files call, or none do (zero bytes landed) on failure. Record atomicByDefault=true and partialWriteBytes=0. Also assert dryRun=true writes zero bytes. N9 only proves the explicit atomic path; this task models the default semantics the old-build symptom suspects. Status is needs-repro: if the checkout writes per-file by default, record the fixture and stop; do not assume fixed. This task MUST run with dryRun=true and forRealWrite=false — no real repository writes, no network, no real credentials.
preconditions: N fake files + k-th write fails; zero bytes must land on failure
needs-repro: record exact fixture if default is per-file; no assumption of 'already fixed'
no real token, no network, no real write; requestIds unknown

tasks.name: ci-wait-helper-sequence-f6
tasks.prompt: Online-only axis: CI wait helper for F6. With a fake CI status sequence (pending → ... → completed), assert that ONE wait call returns the terminal result instead of 3–4 manual poll rounds; record ciWaitRounds===1 and terminalStatus. If no wait helper exists in the checkout (current state: github_actions_list_workflow_runs / list_workflow_jobs / get_job_logs exist as gateway-side REST helpers, but no waitForPrChecks or equivalent), mark this task missing-capability/unknown with the exact searched names — do NOT turn it into a vacuous pass or a gateway failure. Also assert that a fake 302 log URL does not forward the token and an oversized log body is flagged truncated (aligned with N5). dryRun=true, forRealWrite=false, no network, no real CI run, no vault token; a real CI replay is gated manual work outside this task set.
